**Note:** this project is currently in a stated feature-freeze/hardening
posture (see the commit history) — bug fixes, security fixes, performance
fixes and documentation fixes are always welcome, but new functionality is
evaluated more slowly and deliberately. Please still open the issue; it just
may not be picked up immediately.

**What problem does this solve?**

Describe the problem, not just the solution — this makes it easier to spot
a simpler fix, or an existing feature that already covers it (check
[README.md](../../README.md)'s documentation index first).

**Proposed solution**

What you'd like to see, and roughly how it might fit into the existing
design (see [docs/architecture.md](../../docs/architecture.md) and
[docs/project-map.md](../../docs/project-map.md)).

**Alternatives considered**

Anything else you thought about, and why it didn't fit as well.
